g.text: Alpha Financial Analyst — Production scale tier HLD
INTERVIEW DESIGN · not built · the deployed demo tier is scale-to-zero (ADR-0015); each component here moves in on a measured trigger (production-scale-architecture.md).
AWS · us-east-1 · VPC, private subnets, 3 AZs · every stateful component
Amazon Bedrock · US cross-region inference profiles
vectors + manifests → S3 Parquet before staging
CONTRACTS THAT HOLD THE DEPLOYMENT TOGETHER
rerank bedrock Cohere Rerank 3.5 (off until Gate C)
admission rate window → quota → token budget
workers scale on ready jobs per worker
queue SKIP LOCKED → outbox → SQS + DLQ
deploy tag → eval-replay → canary on SLO
Region loss = outage, documented, not built.
replica · Aurora Global DB · warm standby
arrows: navy = request / state purple = model call (dashed = fallback) green = ingestion & release slate dashed = external source orange = edge
